title: PHOTOGRAPHIC MUG KIT
reason: Includes a branded Cricut Mug Press and a second mug heat press plus a carton of blank mugs, so worth more than the title suggests.
findings: Black plastic tub plus a carton. Tub holds: a white Cricut Mug Press (cricut logo clearly visible on the front, mint green cradle inside, black mains lead and plug stuffed inside, lid open) and a separate generic mechanical mug heat press (black base with swing arm and lever, round heater cylinder, separate digital controller box labelled TEMP, TIME, SET and MODE with blank display), plus a large dark flat sheet or pad, two small white boxes and several black square boxes that may be press accessories. Carton holds roughly a dozen boxed blank mugs for sublimation or photo printing, hand labelled in pen white black, white pink and pink glitter, with one mug out showing a pink inner and handle. No model or serial numbers legible. The title does not mention Cricut.
condition: Cricut unit looks clean with no visible cracks; working order untested. The generic press and controller are untested and dusty. Mugs are boxed so condition unknown.
rescore_note: Genuine Cricut Mug Press (logo seen) plus a second generic mug heat press with controller and about a dozen boxed sublimation mugs; untested, but this gear resells readily, so upper half of the $80 to 200 band. (no web price check)
